LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Bus_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Public Use)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Bus_Final.description: Further shapes personality gel with 100% Public Use specialization progress into its final state. This recipe accepts only fully specialized Public Use material and is mutually exclusive with the ordinary Public Use state.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Cow_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Cow)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Cow_Final.description: Further shapes personality gel with 100% Cow specialization progress into its final state. This recipe accepts only fully specialized Cow material and is mutually exclusive with the ordinary Cow state.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_TrainerOfficer_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Training Officer)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_TrainerOfficer_Final.descript: Shapes personality gel into a Final Training Officer. Requires completed Training Officer training and no prior finalization.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetCat_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Pet Cat)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetCat_Final.description: Processes personality gel with Pet Cat as its current path, completed ordinary training and the base Pet Cat state into a final Pet Cat personality. The material must have no final Cat, Dog or Rabbit specialization. Implanting it grants permanent movement speed and melee dodge bonuses and retains affection toward the actual bound master; it also grants Soothing Resonance to recover another player-faction humanlike pawn from a mental state, or briefly encourage its mood and work speed.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetDog_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Pet Dog)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetDog_Final.description: Further shapes personality gel with 100% Pet Dog specialization progress into its final state. This recipe accepts only material that has completed Pet Dog specialization and carries the base Pet Dog state.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetRabbit_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Pet Rabbit)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_PetRabbit_Final.description: Further shapes personality gel with 100% Pet Rabbit specialization progress into its final state. This recipe accepts only material that has completed Pet Rabbit specialization and carries the base Pet Rabbit state.
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Combatant_Final.label: Sex Slave Specialization (Final Combatant)
LanguageData.SSC_PSEdit_Combatant_Final.description: Processes personality gel with Combatant as its current specialization, completed ordinary training and no prior Combatant finalization into final combatant gel. Implanting it grants permanent combat bonuses and Combat Overdrive, which actively stimulates the body's nanomachines. Other final specializations stored in the personality are preserved.
